What good looks like

  1. 1LCP: 2.5 s or less
  2. 2INP: 200 ms or less
  3. 3CLS: 0.1 or less

A click feels slow when the main thread is busy.

The Performance panel shows why.

Open the Performance panel.

Live metrics show your local LCP and CLS at once.

Click on the page, and INP appears too.

A click starts a task on the main thread.

The handler runs.

Only after it ends can the browser paint the next frame.

To see the cause, record a trace.

Set a CPU slowdown in Capture settings,

click Record, click the page, then click Stop.

Good values: LCP 2.5 seconds or less,

INP 200 milliseconds or less, and CLS 0.1 or less.
